title: L’Oréal Travel Retail targets 10% in refillable fragrance solutions at travel hubs by 2030
summary: L’Oréal Travel Retail has signed a joint Sustainability-Linked Business Plan with Avolta, a global travel experience retailer, to expand refillable fragrance formats at its international travel hubs, as well as lower supply chain emissions and scale circular solutions

extraction.key_fact: 로레알 트래블 리테일이 글로벌 유통 기업 아볼타와 협력하여 국제 여행 허브에서 리필형 향수 형식을 확대하고 공급망 배출량을 줄이기 위한 지속가능성 연계 사업 계획을 체결했다.
